description: Shared Renovate policy for every tuna-os repository. Repos consume it with "extends": ["local>tuna-os/.github"] and add only what is genuinely repo-specific (custom managers, per-package holds, postUpgradeTasks).

packageRules.description: Routine bumps merge themselves once the repo's own CI is green. platformAutomerge uses GitHub's native auto-merge, so branch protection still gates every one of them -- nothing is bypassed, it just does not wait for a human to press the button.

Major updates always stop for human review. This is the half of tuna-os/.github#12 that stays: tunaOS#1612 and #1636 were both broad-automerge incidents, and a major bump is the class that breaks a build in ways CI does not always catch.
